blurb: The Tony Knowles Coastal Trail is an 11-mile paved trail from downtown Anchorage to Kincaid Park Chalet along the Cook Inlet coastline. It is easy difficulty, gently graded, and accessible for all fitness levels and ages. The trail is open all year round and offers wildlife viewing and scenic vistas including beluga whales and Mount McKinley (Denali).
